installed_property_code.interpretation: Below vapor mass fraction 1e-6 the HEM mixture sound speed is replaced by saturated-liquid sound speed.

coefficient_caveat: The existing driver directly uses returned pressure-loss coefficients in its energy-loss estimate; this audit retains that convention.

conclusions.efficiency_jump: The installed property backend switches sound-speed model below quality 1e-6, abruptly lowering inlet Mach and removing rotor shock loss.
conclusions.stator_plateau: Fixed reference geometry ratios and nearly constant liquid properties leave a slowly varying Reynolds correction; no reference-angle floor is involved.
